questions.text: How could rim continuity, floor morphology and internal structures be investigated for {crater}? Propose distinct, executable analytical approaches, explain the evidence each requires, and state what the available data can support.
answer_requirements: For each approach, specify its objective, steps, evidence files and limitations; avoid counting paraphrases as additional approaches.
Distinguish visible morphology, features requiring measurement and explanations of their origin.
Treat catalogue morphology codes as historical records rather than ground truth.

questions.text: How could east-west topographic asymmetry in {crater} be tested while distinguishing internal relief from regional background slope? Propose an analysis workflow and necessary checks, without treating the maximum-to-minimum elevation difference along the existing central profile as crater depth.
answer_requirements: When using topographic evidence, identify the elevation reference, units and profile location.
Explain how centre offsets, sampling direction and regional slope could affect the conclusions.
If topography is not selected, acknowledge that elevation asymmetry cannot be tested and identify the missing evidence.

questions.text: How could the spatial correspondence between rims or internal structures in images of {crater} and elevation changes be tested? Propose joint analyses and explain how discrepancies could be attributed to registration problems, resolution differences or possible geomorphic differences.
answer_requirements: Explain explicitly how the two types of evidence are related, rather than merely listing modalities.
Acknowledge that a shared target-centred projection does not establish precise registration of the source products.
If imagery or topography is missing, state which parts cannot be completed and avoid claiming that correspondence has been confirmed.

questions.text: Which testable hypotheses of subsequent modification could be proposed from the local morphology and regional context of {crater}? For each hypothesis, specify supporting and counterevidence to seek, alternative explanations, and distinctions that the current data cannot resolve.
answer_requirements: Distinguish observations from working hypotheses without presupposing a particular modification process.
Allow an assessment of insufficient evidence when support is lacking; multiple mechanisms are not mandatory.
Do not infer composition, absolute age, confirmed volcanic activity or impact parameters from grayscale imagery alone.
